figures.public_caption: Panel (a) shows the photoluminescence (PL) peak shift at 77 K versus laser fluence after intermixing for uncapped quantum dot (QD) structures. Panel (b) displays the PL spectra of intermixed QD-C structures irradiated at various fluences, along with as-grown and nonirradiated control samples. Panel (c) presents the PL linewidth at 77 K as a function of irradiation fluence after intermixing.

general_background.title: Arrival and motion at a growth surface
general_background.summary: In molecular beam epitaxy, incident species reach a surface where adsorption, surface motion and incorporation compete. A species that remains on the surface long enough can migrate to a growth site, while desorption competes with incorporation.
